sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Review findings left as later during the v1.16 relay (s404, s392, s396, s399).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- TUI shows a waiting step as a spinner; give `--phase wait` its own marker (s404).
- `relay-run list` could show how long a step has waited; the heartbeat doc should say a heartbeat ends a wait (s404).
- `counts.roles` misses `ui` when the step has `--parent` (s392).
- Snapshot runs should carry `question` and `waiting_on`; `relay-run answer` should accept a multi-line answer (s396).
- Decide whether the orchestrator's spec check is recorded as a ledger step, and say so in the orchestrator brief (s399).
